ai.summary: Headlines center on Nvidia after a reported CEO exit, with 10 bank downgrades ahead of Q3 results, which is a meaningful weight on SPY and the chip/AI theme. Intel shareholder lawsuits after a 29% one-day drop add to semiconductor weakness, while the OpenAI, SunPower, and microcap deal items are not index-relevant.
